hook_structure: meta/self-referential curiosity-gap hook: direct address about the on-screen caption text itself -> reveal twist ('I didn't write a single word') that pivots into a problem/insider framing about generic auto-captions making everyone look the same

beats.card_text: the CAPTIONS → you're READING right → I didn't → single WORD
beats.read: Single continuous talking-head shot; the hook lives entirely in the escalating word-by-word caption reveal, not in the cut, making the viewer read along until the twist lands.

beats.cutaway_subject: man in gray t-shirt on a couch scrolling his phone, tattooed forearm visible
beats.card_text: most auto CAPTION tools / gives you / ZERO CONTROL
beats.read: Cuts away from the speaker to a relatable phone-scrolling shot to dramatize the frustration, escalating to a bold 'ZERO CONTROL' card as the mini-punchline of the complaint.

beats.cutaway_subject: same man from a side angle near a window, adjusting his cap
beats.read: Very short punch-cut on a single-line card acts as a breath/list-beat, keeping the complaint list punchy without adding new visual information.

beats.cutaway_subject: wide side-profile shot of the man at an editing desk with laptop and mousepad
beats.card_text: SAME STYLE / same boring look / as everyone else
beats.read: A static wide shot lets the complaint breathe while three stacked cards build the sameness argument, matching the visual widening to the widening claim.

beats.cutaway_subject: doorway-framed shot of the man at his desk with a ring light and mixing gear
beats.card_text: in your feed / that's why / I use / SUBMAGIC
beats.read: New framing marks the pivot from problem to solution, ending on the bold brand-name card as the mini-payoff that closes this stretch.

beats.card_text: it auto GENERATES / my CAPTIONS / and makes them fully / without SPENDING too much time / here's exactly / HOW I USE IT
beats.read: Returns to direct-to-camera delivery held in one continuous shot; caption ticker alone carries the pacing while the speaker makes the core product claim.

beats.cutaway_subject: screen recording of the Submagic upload interface with a drag-and-drop file cursor
beats.read: Cuts to a screen-capture demo as literal proof of process; red instructional badges function like tutorial callouts rather than dialogue captions.

beats.cutaway_subject: screen recording of the Submagic style picker and customization panel, cursor selecting fonts/colors
beats.card_text: and pick a style / if you want it / to match your brand / hit customize / change the font / the size / the color
beats.read: One unbroken screen-recording lets the customization flow speak for itself; rapid label swaps simulate a walkthrough voiceover without needing new cuts.

beats.cutaway_subject: screen recording of the Submagic feature toggle list (auto zooms, auto b-rolls, remove bad takes) being switched on
beats.card_text: the animation / everything / and if you wanna / go further / auto B rolls / zoom ins / remove bad takes / it's all in here too
beats.read: Same continuous demo shot stacks feature-name cards to enumerate depth of the tool, with toggle animations visually confirming each spoken claim.

beats.card_text: now EVERY VIDEO / I post / looks like me / tap the link / in my profile / to try SUBMAGIC
beats.read: Cuts back to the speaker for the CTA, mirroring the opening's direct-address framing to bookend the video before the ask.

beats.cutaway_subject: generic TikTok app loading screen transitioning to a search bar showing '@ciggmedia'
beats.read: Stock TikTok loading/search bumper serves as an outro tag driving profile visits, a deliberate templated end-card rather than custom footage.
